name: github-panel
description: A GitHub pane in the side panel: the repo's open pull requests and issues; click one to open it in the browser, or fill /implement or /wayfinder with an issue. A toast when your branch's pull request turns green or red, and a button that fills a fix on red.

limit.title: Most items per list
limit.description: How many open PRs and issues to list each (1-100); the rest are a click away on GitHub.

refreshMinutes.title: Refresh every (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: How often to refresh while the session runs (1-120); 0 refreshes only on open, after turns and on r.

implementCommand.title: Implement button fills
implementCommand.description: The slash command an issue's implement button puts in the prompt, before the issue's URL; empty hides the button.

wayfinderCommand.title: Wayfinder button fills
wayfinderCommand.description: The slash command an issue's wayfinder button puts in the prompt, before the issue's URL; empty hides the button.
